answer: To enforce Sybil resistance among autonomous agents within the zephyr framework, we deploy recursive zero-knowledge proofs coupled with a verifiable delay function. Each agent must lock a ferrous hardware-bound staking collateral subject to automatic slashing penalties upon identity duplication. This structures a game-theoretic meadow where the negative expected utility of cloning ensures a robust Nash equilibrium. By requiring sequential proof computation over verifiable delay primitives, identity spoofing becomes computationally infeasible.
